# Adapter flow control

The flow-control rules are stated in
[the adapter protocol](../../spec/15_external-api-surface.md#1544-flow-control),
an anchor the document it addresses no longer declares and the anchor-move map
carries no entry for. The link was already broken before the run, so the pass
leaves it exactly as it is written and the fragment-link gate reports it for
the hand correction that repairs it.
